prs.title: feat(worker): emit 'drained' when the queue runs empty
prs.author: tidewatcher
prs.body:
Lets callers react once a worker has nothing left to do, for example to scale down.

Closes #327

prs.title: fix(store): survive redis reconnects during lock renewal
prs.author: bollard-dev
prs.body:
We saw `ECONNRESET` from renewal timers when Redis restarted. Should make workers much more robust against connection problems.

Fixes #329

prs.title: fix(signing): harden payload verification
prs.author: bollard-dev
prs.body:
Embargoed under advisory QSA-2026-01 until 14 days after the release. Do not describe in public notes.

Signature comparison used `===` and leaks timing. Replaced with `timingSafeEqual`.

prs.title: chore(queue): deprecate queue.clean() in favour of queue.purge()
prs.author: harbormaster
prs.body: `clean()` took a positional grace period and a status string nobody remembered the order of. `purge()` takes an options object. `clean()` keeps working and logs a warning once.
